source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 242 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 242.

PD 242.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 242 was established by Ordinance No. 19219, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 16, 1986. Ordinance No. 19219 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 242 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Crossman Avenue and Toronto Street. The size of PD 242 is approximately 21,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must be in accordance with the site plan (Exhibit 242A). (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping must be provided in accordance with the landscaping plan (see site plan). All landscaping must be installed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy and must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.106. PERMITTED USES.

The only permitted uses on the Property are a day care center and a community center. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.107. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

(a) Maximum permitted floor area for the day care center use is 4,900 square feet.

(b) Maximum permitted floor area for the community center use is 2,976 square feet.

(c) Maximum permitted floor area for the gymnasium use is 3,250 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.108. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted coverage of the Property is 40 percent. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.109. MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height for any structure is 29 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.110. MINIMUM SETBACKS.

(a) Minimum front yard setback of 20 feet must be provided.

(b) Minimum side yard setback of five feet must be provided. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.111. OFF-STREET PARKING.

A minimum of 16 parking spaces must be provided on the Property. A maximum of four parking spaces may be provided in the front yard area along Crossman Avenue. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Number Of Students
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.112. NUMBER OF STUDENTS.

A maximum of 90 children are permitted in the day care center at one time. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Outdoor Play Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.113. OUTDOOR PLAY AREA.

A minimum of 100 square feet of outdoor play area must be provided for each child in the play area at one time. A minimum of 5,700 square feet of play area must be provided on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.114. ACCESS.

A driveway must be provided in accordance with the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.115. SIGNS.

No detached signs may be erected on the Property. All attached signs must comply with the requirements for non-business zoning districts contained in Section 51-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.116. FENCING.

The outdoor play area must be totally enclosed by a minimum four-foot-high fence, as shown on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.117. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-242.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 242 is located on Zoning Map No. J-6. (Ord. Nos. 19219; 25711)
